catalysts.headline: Sangoma enters definitive arrangement agreement to be acquired by BRC Group Holdings, Inc. for US$4.925 cash plus 0.04767 of a BRC common share per Sangoma share
catalysts.impact: Implied value of US$5.225 (C$7.40)/share based on BRC's 20-day VWAP — approx. 47% premium to prior closing price, approx. 51% to 10-day VWAP; transaction enterprise value approx. US$204M (C$289M); aggregate cash consideration approx. US$170M. Unanimously approved by Sangoma board on recommendation of a special committee; directors/officers holding ~27% of shares signed voting support agreements. Deal requires approval by 2/3 of votes cast at a special meeting plus a simple majority excluding MI 61-101 interested shares, plus court, Investment Canada Act, US HSR, FCC and state telecom regulatory approvals. Closing expected early 2027 (one source cites outside date of 2027-01-22).
